en.title: Letters Whose Lowercase Forms All Come Before Uppercase
en.description:
Count the distinct English letters that appear in both lowercase and uppercase, where every lowercase occurrence of the letter comes before every uppercase occurrence. Count by letter only.

This site uses a standard input/output protocol; ranges not given by the source are stated explicitly.
en.input: One line containing a string of English letters of length 1..100000, consisting only of a-z and A-Z.
en.output: Output a single integer, the answer.
en.explanation: Example 1: the lowercase a, b, and c all appear first, so 3 letters count. Example 2: a appears in lowercase again after A, so it does not qualify; b has no lowercase form, for a total of 0. Example 3: every letter appears only in uppercase, so 0.
hints: Record each letter's last lowercase position and first uppercase position; the letter qualifies if both exist and the former is smaller.
